paired_unit: demand day x runtime seed; common exogenous streams, not shared policy outcomes
admission: exact native action/timing/endpoint equivalence, causal query/APC fields and prefix clocks; verify common exogenous streams are indexed independently of policy event counts
forecasts: strict completed current-day APC/AVL visits per direction/stop; minimum 3; last 3 visits must be uncensored for boarded/gap rate; all completed alight/incoming and mean run; no future queues or destinations
horizon: query + longest route upper bound (ceil mean run +104 nonterminal service, native query/transition ticks, up to45 legal holding) +360*fleet+1; launches with public release <= query+360*fleet; fixed across candidates

solver.fallback: retain native on unsupported prefix or no feasible strict gain

operational_obligations: commands already issued and current service are fixed; first current legal command only; future plan revisable at every query; FIFO native return+1 dispatch, no terminal holding
model_constraints: CV2, first return and next launch per active vehicle, and each included public launch delay no worse than same-query bilateral forecast; equal comparison boundaries, no H-as-slack
statistics: 8 day/runtime pairs, paired means and 95% crossed day/runtime bootstrap; single actor is a development anchor, not an actor-generalization claim
endpoints: total public dispatch delay including control waits
continue_gate: APC arm passenger upper95<0 and CV2/readiness/public-delay upper95<=0 vs unchanged baseline; no extra unfinished service; repeat effect direction in both runtime-seed halves; APC-vs-homogeneous must improve the same tradeoff, otherwise no allocation-information claim
failure_decision: close this frozen pilot if joint gate fails; no forecast/window/weight tuning on its outcomes
independent_confirmation: new demand days and remaining actors require a separate release after development gain; only then matched-budget frequency ablations
